hooks.command: command -v upskill >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; n=$(upskill update --notice 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s\n' "$n" | tr '\001-\011\013-\037' ' ' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' | awk 'NR>1{printf "\\n"} {printf "%s",$0}'); printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$t" "$t"
